title: Nvidia has released Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, an open model with 120 billion parameters aimed at business AI agents that run continuously, along with two smaller models for local computers.
key_facts: Nvidia released Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, open multimodal, 120B parameters with 12B active per token
Built for enterprise agents running continuously; developed with the Nemotron Coalition (Mistral AI, Thinking Machines Lab, Perplexity, Black Forest Labs)
Two smaller Bolt models for local PCs and edge devices: 74B-A9B 24GB now, E4B 4GB later this month
Nvidia says it matches Nemotron 3 Ultra accuracy with about one-fifth the parameters on agent tasks
Up to five times the throughput of similar open models on a single GPU, per Nvidia citing Artificial Analysis
Also releases training data and open datasets, including one with 22 Indian languages
Nvidia recently invested $12.9 billion in Hugging Face (per The Decoder)
quote_evidence: Nvidia has released Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, an open multimodal model with 120 billion parameters built for enterprise agents.
Nvidia releases the models openly but tunes them for its own products, from data center servers to workstations.
The strategy behind Nvidia's open models is self-serving.
why_it_matters_hint: Open models let firms fine-tune on their own data and keep it on their own servers.
notes: Full text read. Performance numbers are Nvidia's claims; EXO Labs test is the one independent test cited.
